MONEY_SOURCES: How the savings tie out: Hut 8 has 830 MW under construction at a guided $9M to $11M per MW, roughly $8B of construction value in flight. That agrees with the $7.5B of project bonds closed in 2026 at up to 85% loan to cost. Industry studies put change orders from design errors alone at 3 to 5% of construction budget, and documented savings from BIM clash detection reach 10% of contract value. Hut 8's Tier 1 partners already run BIM, so Yurt 8 claims only the owner side residual: year one claims well under 1% of a watched slice of that work, plus eliminated third party fees and schedule value. And schedule value is not phantom revenue: the project bonds cost about $1.27M per day in interest at full draw, so a handful of protected days pays for this program many times over. Run the same benchmarks at base case capture and year one lands between $8M and $16M; I pitch the conservative number on purpose. PROMPT_ABRIDGED:
You are helping me, a senior BIM and generative design program manager, produce a case study requested by Hut 8. It presents my end to end strategy for digital delivery of the full AECO lifecycle for Hut 8's portfolio. The system is named Yurt 8, a playful nod to Hut 8.

VOICE: read my writing samples first and match them. Speak like a layman. No em dashes. Technical depth lives in Show My Homework and stays readable.

FIRST PRINCIPLES, the filter for every element: keep it simple; cut cost; cut time; raise quality; inherently scalable, a living system, never a stagnant tool. If a step does not directly advance these, cut it.

THE SYSTEM: a gamified system letting an owner plan site selection, preconstruction, design, construction, and operations with high confidence. Core loop: REVIEW, GENERATE, LEARN. A pizza tracker style chronological tracker; every project progresses along it; each milestone connects to its critical data sources. Review means real time visibility: live Revit and CAD feeds, standardized spreadsheets, plain English RFIs, clashes as they occur, through ACC APIs plus Procore, Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Project. Generate means deterministic algorithms and LLMs connected via MCP in alternating gated layers, proven on live projects, running in a browser through the Design Automation API. Learn means Bedrock agents on S3 data lakes, knowledge bases gated by review. All three share the exact same JSON format so each step flows into the next.

DELIVERABLES: a two page PDF brochure structured as a chronological timeline, and a single self contained interactive HTML experience with a working 3D component, under 15MB, that runs offline. Use a web native 3D stack; write in NVIDIA Omniverse as the future production path. Use a multi agent build: one orchestrating agent driving many sub agents.

RULES: never mention prior employers. Ground every dollar in Hut 8's real public filings. Every claim traceable. Show my homework, including this prompt. Build, render, critique against requirements, fix, repeat. Do not stop after the first working version.
